summary_en: This Phase 3 study tests zanidatamab added to cisplatin and gemcitabine, with or without durvalumab or pembrolizumab, compared with that standard treatment alone, in advanced HER2-positive biliary tract cancer. All study drugs are given by intravenous (IV) infusion, and the record does not state how long or how often. The record does not state the main outcome measure; the study is Phase 3.
summary_es: Este estudio de Fase 3 evalúa zanidatamab añadido a cisplatino y gemcitabina, con o sin durvalumab o pembrolizumab, en comparación con ese tratamiento estándar solo, en colangiocarcinoma o cáncer de vías biliares avanzado con HER2 positivo. Todos los medicamentos del estudio se administran por infusión intravenosa (IV), y el registro no indica por cuánto tiempo ni con qué frecuencia. El registro no indica la medida de resultado principal; el estudio es de Fase 3.
who_for: Advanced, unresectable, or metastatic biliary tract cancer not eligible for curative resection, transplant, or ablation.
HER2-positive tumor, defined as IHC 3+, or IHC 2+ with ISH positive.
No more than 2 cycles of cisplatin and gemcitabine, with or without a PD-1/L1 inhibitor, for advanced disease.
Assessable disease (measurable or non-measurable) per RECIST 1.1.
Age 18 or older with ECOG performance status 0 or 1.
not_for: Prior treatment with a HER2-targeted agent.
Prior checkpoint inhibitor treatment other than durvalumab or pembrolizumab.
Certain rare biliary histologic subtypes, such as small cell, neuroendocrine, lymphoma, or sarcoma.
Use of systemic corticosteroids, brain metastases, or history of interstitial lung disease or non-infectious pneumonitis.
